ja313:1.1: Yo te hatthe ca pāde ca kaṇṇanāsañ ca chedayi tassa kujjha mahāvīra, mā raṭṭhaṃ vinasā idan ti.
ja313:2.1: Yo me hatthe ca pāde ca kaṇṇanāsañ ca chedayi (cfr. Alwis, Sidhat Sangarawa P. CLX) ciraṃ jīvatu so rājā, na hi kujjhanti mādisā ti.
ja313:3.1: Ahu atītamaddhāne samaṇo {khantidīpano}, taṃ khantiyā ṭyeva hitaṃ Kāsirājā achedayi.
ja313:4.1: Tassa kammassa pharusassa vipāko kaṭuko ahu yaṃ Kāsirājā vedesi nirayamhi samappito ti
